text:
emily_support: FYI LedgerWorks reported INV-2026-034 shows PO 98765 but the 'bill_to' entity is 'Redwood Labs' (US) instead of 'Redwood Inference Ltd' (UK). Their AP rejected it. Invoice was paid by card on 2026-03-05. Customer asks if we can reissue without forcing a card refund.

raj_billing: Can you attach the invoice PDF + payment receipt? I need to confirm paid amount and payment method.

emily_support: attached: INV-2026-034.pdf, payment_receipt_1234.png (from customer). Payment = £12,450.00, last4=4242, paid 2026-03-05.

raj_billing: If paid by card we normally do: (A) Refund to card then reissue OR (B) Create internal credit note + new invoice and let customer apply credit. Since they prefer no card refund, option B is viable but requires finance signoff for cross-entity accounting.

marta_finance: Looping in finance ops. @sam_support_manager any objections? Need signoff because this is cross-entity + VAT implications. What was the tax jurisdiction on the original invoice?

emily_support: Original tax country: UK. Customer entity = LedgerWorks Ltd (GB), they require vendor = 'Redwood Inference Ltd' VAT reg. Current invoice lists 'Redwood Labs LLC' (US) which triggered AP block.

marta_finance: UK VAT note: reissuing under correct entity can change VAT treatment. We need Redwood Inference Ltd VAT number and proof of registration. Please collect vendor tax docs from customer. Mark this high priority — their payment is held.

sam_support_manager: :thumbsup: assigning to @raj_billing to prepare credit note draft and to @marta_finance for tax signoff. Raj, follow billing playbook 'billing/reissue-v2' — https://redwood.kb/docs/billing/reissue-v2

raj_billing: On it. Drafting credit note now. Quick Q: playbook calls this 'refund avoidance' flow (step 3) — confirm we should use internal credit note rather than refund to card? Customer explicitly asked to avoid direct refund.

marta_finance: Yes — use internal credit note + new invoice, pending our VAT verification. I'll approve once we have the vendor VAT number. Note: tax team may require an adjusting ledger entry; expect ~24h of processing after signoff.

emily_support: I emailed LedgerWorks AP asking (a) confirm they accept internal credit + new invoice instead of refund, (b) provide Redwood Inference Ltd VAT number and any vendor docs. CC'd finance@redwood.com. Customer ETA: by EOD.

ops-bot: Ticket BI-78321 updated: billing/reissue workflow started; assignees: raj_billing, marta_finance; SLA: 72h.

raj_billing: Draft credit note created: CN-2026-009 (internal). New invoice prepared INV-2026-034-R1 with corrected bill_to entity. Holding issuance until finance signoff and customer confirmation. Will not issue card refund unless requested.

marta_finance: Approved pending customer VAT number. Once received, I'll confirm VAT treatment and instruct accounting to post CN and publish new invoice. Expect ledger adjustments within 24h after signoff.

emily_support: Thanks — will ping customer in 2 hours if no reply and update ticket.
